passage: The Bachelor of Business degree is offered online with a duration of 36 months. You'll study in a small cohort of around 25 students under the expert guidance of an Online Facilitator who has industry experience and academic qualifications in your field of study. The Marketing major prepares graduates for roles in digital marketing, brand management, campaign strategy, and customer analytics across industries like retail, advertising, technology, and consumer goods. Entry-level salaries start around AU$70,000, rising to AU$100,000+ for senior roles like marketing manager. The major is AMI-accredited, offering a faster path to Certified Practising Marketer (CPM) status and recognition from the UK's Chartered Institute of Marketing.

At RMIT, you can take a third-year elective as a first-year student as long as you meet the course requirements and your program structure permits it. The RMIT Course Requisites policy states that Enrolment Online will block enrolment if a course has system-enforced prerequisites you haven't completed; however, if you have equivalent background knowledge, you can apply for an Enforced Requisite Waiver. If the elective lists only "Assumed Knowledge" rather than enforced prerequisites, you can self-enrol, though RMIT advises reviewing the Course Guide or contacting the Course Coordinator to ensure you can manage the course level.

When you successfully complete this degree, you may be eligible for entry into a range of RMIT Honours and postgraduate qualifications in related business and commerce disciplines. These include: Master's degrees, such as the Master of Commerce, Master of Analytics, Master of Data Science, Master of Business Analytics and AI Strategy, Master of Finance, Master of Business Administration, Master of Marketing, Master of International Business, and Master of Professional Accounting, among others. Graduate Diplomas,  such as the Graduate Diploma in Project Management. Graduate Certificates are shorter (typically 6-month full-time) qualifications in areas like Commerce, Analytics, Business Information Technology, Digital Economy, Finance, Marketing, and HR Management.

The Bachelor of Graphic Design offers four majors: Branding, Experience Design, Illustration, and Typography. The Branding major focuses on strategies and visual techniques that shape brand identity. Experience Design focuses on creating user-centred experiences. Illustration develops visual storytelling skills through drawing and digital techniques. Typography explores lettering and typography across different media.

Graduates of the Bachelor of Graphic Design can pursue careers including communication designer, creative director, graphic designer, illustrator, service designer, and user experience designer. The individual majors also provide pathways to roles such as brand strategist, visual identity designer, UX/UI designer, interaction designer, concept artist, visual storyteller, book designer, publication designer, and specialist typographer.

The Bachelor of Design (Games) provides specialist training in computer-generated design, with particular emphasis on game studies and art practice. Students develop skills across design, narrative, imaging, modelling and animation in 2D and 3D, concept art, and game environments.
Entry to the Bachelor of Design (Games) requires VCE Units 3 and 4 with a study score of at least 25 in English other than EAL, or at least 27 in English as an Additional Language (EAL).
